_doc: Entity templates placed on the maps through each map's legend. Companions: '<id>_town' is where they are first met (when: absent), '<id>_camp' is where they wait when not in the party (when: camp).

reeve.name: Reeve Maren Aldous
reeve.portrait: A human woman in her fifties, tired but resolute, with iron-grey hair in a tight bun and sharp eyes, wearing a dark green official's coat with a gold chain of office. The town's reeve.

bram.name: Bram
bram.portrait: A stout, cheerful human innkeeper, bald with a thick brown beard and rosy cheeks, wearing a linen shirt and a stained apron, a tankard in hand.

tova.name: Tova Ironhand
tova.portrait: A muscular human blacksmith woman with dark brown skin, black hair tied back and a smudge of soot on her cheek, wearing a heavy leather apron, with a confident half-smile.

elsbeth.name: Widow Elsbeth
elsbeth.portrait: An elderly human widow with a gentle, worried face and grey hair under a dark shawl, hands clasped.

gate_guard.name: Gate Guard
gate_guard.portrait: A young human town guard in a dented kettle helmet and a red tabard, with a bored, slightly nervous expression, leaning on a spear.

edrin.name: Edrin
edrin.portrait: A lanky young farm lad with sandy curls, a sunburned freckled face and wide frightened eyes, wearing a patched homespun shirt.

snagrot.name: Snagrot
snagrot.portrait: A scrawny green goblin chieftain with enormous pointed ears, yellow eyes and a jagged-toothed grin, wearing a dented stolen helmet that is too big for him.

stolen_crate.name: A crate with a smith's mark

interact.text: The fire crackles. Beyond its light the night is cold and very quiet.

options.text: Rest until morning. (Restores hit points, spells and daily powers.)

interact.text: A trampled trail leads out of the pines, back the way you came.
Someone camped here before you and left a cache under oilcloth, with a note: 'For whoever needs it more.'
The lid grinds open. Grave goods - and, on a rotted cord, a heavy iron key.
